summary: An intimate, low-scale architecture about two sisters rebuilding trust after a fire. The proposal deliberately leaves genre, setting, cast, and concrete events unknown. It offers a relational engine of unequal need and practical care, a structure of small reparations, and an emotional progression from guarded grief to a partial, earned trust.

nodes.title: Repair engine
nodes.summary: Every offer of help is also a risk of reopening the injury, so repair advances through small, reversible acts rather than a single reconciliation.

nodes.title: Asymmetric need
nodes.summary: The sisters need different things from the relationship, so care cannot be symmetrical and trust must be negotiated.

nodes.title: Shared work
nodes.summary: Practical cooperation gives the sisters evidence about each other that conversation alone cannot supply.

nodes.title: Small reparation
nodes.summary: A modest, repeatable act of care matters more than a grand apology.

nodes.title: Memory of the fire
nodes.summary: The fire is a shared history whose meaning each sister has organized differently.

nodes.title: Practical care
nodes.summary: Love becomes credible through ordinary maintenance rather than declarations.

nodes.title: Guarded grief
nodes.summary: The reader feels grief held at a distance, with relief and wariness arriving together.

nodes.title: Earned trust
nodes.summary: Trust becomes believable because it is built from repeated, imperfect evidence.

phases.title: Aftermath
phases.aesthetic: Ordinary domestic detail with one conspicuous absence.
phases.narrative_function: Establish guarded contact and unequal need.

phases.title: Guarded contact
phases.narrative_function: Test small offers of help without demanding reconciliation.

phases.title: Shared work
phases.narrative_function: Let cooperation produce evidence that trust is possible.
phases.transition: A remembered detail about the fire changes each sister's interpretation.

phases.title: Earned trust
phases.aesthetic: Modest warmth that does not erase loss.
phases.narrative_function: Let trust be partial, chosen, and still vulnerable.
phases.transition: The sisters choose a modest ongoing practice of care.

open_questions: What genre and setting should frame the story? The Vision does not establish one.
What exactly did each sister lose in the fire, and do they disagree about what happened?
Which sister wants repair, and which one resists it?
Should trust remain partial at the ending, or should the story imagine a durable reconciliation?

emotion_targets.intended_effect: Earned trust that feels modest, specific, and still vulnerable.
emotion_targets.eliciting_condition: A sister keeps a small promise after it would have been easier to withdraw.
emotion_targets.aesthetic_strategy: Concrete domestic detail and restrained warmth.

emotion_targets.intended_effect: Grief for the home and former relationship that cannot be restored.
emotion_targets.eliciting_condition: A familiar routine is performed without the person or place that gave it meaning.

emotion_targets.intended_effect: Wariness that trust might be punished again.
emotion_targets.eliciting_condition: An offer of help could become a new debt or accusation.

emotion_targets.intended_effect: Anger at old injuries that were never acknowledged.
emotion_targets.eliciting_condition: One sister's version of the past erases the other's loss.
emotion_targets.aesthetic_strategy: Sharp, specific disagreement inside an otherwise quiet scene.

emotion_targets.intended_effect: Surprise when an ordinary act of care lands more meaningfully than expected.
emotion_targets.eliciting_condition: A small kindness is offered without a demand attached.
emotion_targets.aesthetic_strategy: A plain gesture that the other sister notices but cannot immediately answer.

complex_emotions.title: Guarded hope
complex_emotions.context: Relief and fear arrive together when trust is offered.

complex_emotions.title: Trust through grief
complex_emotions.context: A partial repair makes room for both continuing care and acknowledged loss.
